messages:
Ana (Design): Quick design review — here's a compact 'compare p95' mock I uploaded: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234 Ana (Design): TL;DR: add an inline 'Compare' toggle in the p95 stack header, hover scrubber that shows delta lines, and a collapsed compact mode for long model lists. Jonah (Eng): Love the idea. Question: how would the scrubber interact with existing sampling logic? could be expensive if we fetch full traces. Ana (Design): scrubber is client-side delta between cached p95 buckets. backend only needed for absolute numbers or deep trace on click. Matt (PM): Product nit: default compare mode should be relative (%) so teams see regressions quickly. add a small 'show absolute' control in the tooltip. Sarah (SRE): Agree on relative default. Also pls add a sampling preset UI — we shouldn't let "compact" hide systemic regressions. presets: Live (1%), Stable (10%), Full (100%). Queenie (A11y): A11y nits: keyboard nav for the toggle, focus order, and screen-reader text for the scrubber. Contrast numbers look low on the delta line (ratio ~2.8). We need >=4.5:1 for text/controls. Ana (Design): Good call. Updated microcopy proposals: - Toggle label: "Compare to baseline" (tooltip: "Compare current p95 to selected baseline window") - Scrubber tooltip header: "Delta: +12% (p95) — 120ms → 135ms" - Sampling presets menu: use radio group with short descriptions. Jonah (Eng): rough eng estimate: 2 working days to wire basic toggle + tooltip, +1 day for sampling presets + tests. if we need server changes for full absolute fetch that's extra. Ana (Design): code snippet for aria suggestion: ```
Scrubber delta: +12%
``` Queenie (A11y): add `aria-roledescription=\"scrubber\"` and explicit focusable handles. Also ensure tooltip content exposed to SR on hover + keyboard focus. Matt (PM): Filing follow-up: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/INF-4923 — pls add acceptance criteria: default relative, presets, aria notes, perf budget. design-bot: Uploaded image: compact-compare-v2.png :frame_with_picture: Ana (Design): I'll iterate in Figma and update the mock + add the a11y checklist to the Linear issue. Thanks :heart: Matt (PM): SGTM :thumbsup: Jonah (Eng): I'll reserve a slot for implementation next sprint. Sarah (SRE): can we add a quick smoke job to surface sampling regressions after rollout? small ask. Ana (Design): Added to the ticket as a follow-up. Done.
